title: game.Collectible
description: A coin (assets/prefabs/coin.prefab.json, tagged `pickup`): counts itself into the [GameState] at `start`, and when the player (the object tagged `player`) enters its `collect` zone (a `fynkel.TriggerZone` with `once`) it scores, plays [pickup] once (M3-11: a fire-and-forget `world.audio.play` — the coin is gone a tick later, so no source on it could finish), leaves a burst of sparks (the `burst` prefab instantiated at runtime, its pieces kicked apart and despawned by their `LifetimeDespawn`) and destroys itself: the coin is its prefab's root, so nothing of the coin stays.

pickup.description: The pickup sound (assets/audio/coin.ogg; silent when unset).

value.description: Points this coin is worth (the HUD counts coins, not points; here for the schema's sake and a future scoreboard).
